cues.text: Naganaki Shrine during the summer festival: the path is lined with stalls under strings of paper lanterns, and people stroll between them. You stand with Yukari, who is wearing a yukata, beside a lottery stall, both of you watching a woman in a yukata pass by.
You and Yukari make your way through the crowd to a takoyaki stand, where a woman works behind the counter.
A little later, you and Yukari stand off to one side near a stone guardian statue, Yukari holding the tray of takoyaki. She picks one up and pops it into her mouth.
You step up to the lottery stall's counter, reach into the box on it and draw a ticket, while Yukari watches from beside you.
